policy_document_constraint.reason: The installed policy schema and loader reject fields beyond claim, candidate_contract, public_canary, live_evidence, and live_evidence_max_age_days. TR-0 permits no behavior change and does not own those runtime files, so the findings are retained here instead of changing policy interpretation.

claude-code.working_directory: Handlers run in Claude Code's current directory; if it no longer exists, documented fallback directories are tried.
claude-code.timeout: Command hooks default to 600 seconds; configured timeout is in seconds.
claude-code.crash_or_nonzero: Exit 2 blocks. Other failures continue unless onFailure is block.

codex-cli.working_directory: Commands run with the session cwd.
codex-cli.timeout: Most command hooks default to 600 seconds; configured timeout is in seconds.
codex-cli.crash_or_nonzero: The documentation reports errors and timeouts as hook failures. PreToolUse error, timeout, or malformed output can let the tool run; explicit exit 2 or a documented denial blocks supported tool calls.

gemini-cli.working_directory: Input includes cwd and the sanitized environment includes GEMINI_CWD; command process cwd semantics were not explicitly determined.
gemini-cli.timeout: Default 60000 milliseconds; configured timeout is in milliseconds.
gemini-cli.crash_or_nonzero: Exit 2 is a system block. Other nonzero exits are warnings and the interaction proceeds. Timeout-specific continuation behavior was not explicitly determined.

opencode.working_directory: Plugin context exposes ctx.location.directory, but it is not the location of every observed session or event; per-event process cwd semantics were not determined.
opencode.timeout: Unknown. The official plugin hook documentation reviewed does not specify a hook timeout contract.
opencode.crash_or_nonzero: The official migration example throws from execute.before to reject a protected read. General crash handling and timeout behavior were not determined.
